intro: Davy makes centrepiece styling easy. With clever shelf storage and clear display under glass, it's our way of helping you keep things functional and always tidy.

features.title: We give you storage that’s always within reach
features.text: With open shelves on both sides, our table keeps your essentials accessible from any angle—whether it's remotes, books, or your go-to coasters.

features.title: A display zone that keeps your style grounded
features.text: The bottom shelf lets you showcase books, baskets, or décor while keeping the tabletop free—so you stay tidy without losing personality.

features.title: Light in look, tough in build
features.text: The toughened glass top keeps things feeling airy, while standing strong against daily wear.

features.title: Portable and layout-friendly
features.text: Easy to move and position, our table is designed to fit into living setups big and small, all while adapting to your layout needs.

features.title: Tone that invites conversation
features.text: Warm wood surfaces paired with black legs make it a versatile, cosy addition to any sofa setting.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
